notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Just a quick announcement: the game will release on [b]July 31st![/b]

I hope that you'll enjoy helping [b]King Shorty escape![/b]
Making this game meant a lot to me and I'm incredibly excited to share the final result with you.

Of course, if you run into any issues report them on the Steam forums and I'll do my best to address them.

King Shorty is waiting for your help!
Thanks for your support and [b]have a great day![/b]

-Giuseppe

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

It’s been about a while since I've launched the Steam page, and I’m super excited about the small but awesome results I’ve gathered. 
[b]Every step counts![/b] 
Honestly, reaching this point in the project feels like a big milestone for me.

My [b]ultimate goal[/b] is to create a fun little (or should I say short-y? Ahaha, so funny, nevermind) puzzle game, centered around pathfinding. 
It doesn’t have to be overly complex, both in terms of story and design, just a fun experience that’s a bit challenging at times.

If you are curious about the project and its "behind the scenes", I invite you to read the devblogs that are already present in the Steam News/Discussions, and the others that will come in the following weeks.

With that in mind, I’m thrilled to announce that the demo of "Will The King Escape?" is coming out... right now! 

Your [b]feedback[/b] will be super important to me as I evaluate the design choices I made during development. 
It also gives you the opportunity to play the game for free and see if it’s right for you. 
As of now, I have the game mostly finished, but I plan to revisit some mechanics after the demo's release.

Consider [b]following me[/b] and adding the game to [b]your wishlist[/b] if you want to stay notified about the game release!
This whole process is pretty new to me, but I want to deliver the best experience I can.
 
I’m not quite sure how to wrap this up, so here’s a random thing for bonus points!

What a professionally unprofessional thing to do.

Check out this Gameover!

I hope you won’t see it as much as I’d like!
